about: hxq fmt of the body-policy layouts (if/else-if chain, comprehension, loop body, value-if, try/catch, deep nests) under the sameLine, leftCurly and maxLineLength settings, and of fit-line bodies holding an object literal under the literal-threshold and cross configs (Lit3 keeps its staircase, Glue glues the breaking literal to its header in one write). Seeded from the SIZE-5A and WRITER-FIXPOINT-BRACELESS-SPLIT reviews.

files.typecolon/Probe.hx:
typedef F = (?call:Int, x:String, Int) -> Bool;
typedef G<T:A & B> = T;

invocations.note: if/else-if chain with head-gap trail and own-line lead comments, comprehension Allman body, loop if-else body, value-if, try/catch under next on every body policy + leftCurly before

invocations.name: c3/Probe.hx
invocations.note: if/else-if chain with head-gap trail and own-line lead comments, comprehension Allman body, loop if-else body, value-if, try/catch under same on every body policy + maxLineLength 40

invocations.note: if/else-if chain with head-gap trail and own-line lead comments, comprehension Allman body, loop if-else body, value-if, try/catch under fitLine body policies + maxLineLength 60

invocations.name: c5/Probe.hx
invocations.note: if/else-if chain with head-gap trail and own-line lead comments, comprehension Allman body, loop if-else body, value-if, try/catch under Allman (leftCurly before) + elseIf next

invocations.name: deep/Deep.hx
invocations.note: 60-deep else-if chain, 9-deep for-comprehension nest, 12 nested bare ifs with dangling else; leftCurly before

invocations.name: doc-edges/Probe.hx
invocations.note: an enum body holding a doc comment under enumEmptyLines.beginTypeIfDocComments / endTypeIfDocComments 1: one blank line after { and one before }

invocations.name: fitlit-sweep/Lit3.hx
invocations.note: three nested fit-line hosts over an object literal that fits its line: the staircase the hosts take for any other body, not glued headers

invocations.name: fitlit-xconfig/Lit3.hx
invocations.note: three nested fit-line hosts over an object literal that fits its line: the staircase the hosts take for any other body, not glued headers

invocations.name: fitlit-sweep/Glue.hx
invocations.note: a fit-line body whose object literal breaks (if, for and while hosts, and three nested hosts): one write reaches the fixed point and glues the literal to the header; a writer that cannot read its own break back warns on stderr that it needed two rewrites

invocations.name: fitlit-xconfig/Glue.hx
invocations.note: a fit-line body whose object literal breaks (if, for and while hosts, and three nested hosts): one write reaches the fixed point and glues the literal to the header; a writer that cannot read its own break back warns on stderr that it needed two rewrites

invocations.name: trailing-flat/Probe.hx
invocations.note: flat array, nested array, map, object literal, call and new-args lists each ending on a source trailing comma, under the default wrapping.trailingComma=remove: every comma is dropped

invocations.name: trailing-keep/Probe.hx
invocations.note: under wrapping.trailingComma=keep with fillLine call arguments at width 60: a source trailing comma survives on a flat call holding a collection argument, on method-chain segment calls flat and broken, on a call whose block lambda breaks, and on a call glued around an object-literal argument that breaks (`}, c,)`)

invocations.name: cond-splice-quoted/C2.hx
invocations.note: an else-led #if splice whose condition holds a quoted paren: the generated splice predicate skips the operand through CondDirectives.skipConditionAtom (quote-aware), so the fragment takes the raw-capture fallback instead of unexpected input

invocations.name: cond-splice-stray-close/C11.hx
invocations.note: a stray close paren in the #if operand runs the operand to the end, so the splice is not else-led and fmt refuses it (exit 1)

invocations.name: paren-in-list/C.hx
invocations.note: a +/- or && chain parenthesis that is an array element or map value under the default noWrap rule opens as a container when the chain breaks (maxLineLength 40)

invocations.name: try-overflow/T.hx
invocations.note: a value try whose body holds a wide flat-source array reaches its ladder fixed point in one writer rewrite (expressionTryOverflow next): the array the writer broke counts in the group fit on the next pass

invocations.name: try-list-body/Q.hx
invocations.note: a bracket-list try or catch body takes its own line under the default next layout, as every other body does; a curly block stays on the head line

invocations.name: try-statement-barrier/Min.hx
invocations.note: a kept array in an if statement inside a value try (closure body, braced try and catch body, arrow closure) lays out as the same statement outside a try: the group's kept-list flag stops at the statement list

invocations.name: meta-keys/Src.hx
invocations.note: lineEnds.metadataFunction and metadataVar each break the sites of their own key, module-level function and var included: an engine without these keys leaves every line as written

invocations.name: explicit-nowrap/Min.hx
invocations.note: a multi-line object literal under an explicit noWrap goes flat, and the multi-line typedef body beside it goes flat too

invocations.name: end-orphan/Min.hx
invocations.note: a type body ending in an orphan doc takes its stated endType after the doc, in front of the close curly

invocations.name: comment-only/Min.hx
invocations.note: a type body of comments only takes no end-edge blanks, a stated endType included

invocations.name: chain-force-then/T.hx
invocations.note: an else block holding an if joins the chain: one rewrite under singleStatementBraces remove

invocations.name: in-for-loop/T.hx
invocations.note: a try whose catch is a loop keeps its braces inside a loop body: one rewrite under singleStatementBraces remove

invocations.name: do/A.hx
invocations.note: a same-line comment after `do` before a non-block body: it stays on the keyword line and the body takes the next (known defect until WRITER-DO-COMMENT: fmt refused, the round trip dropped the comment)

invocations.name: do/B.hx
invocations.note: guard: comment-free do-while bodies (bare and block), and the comments after `while (…)`, `for (…)` and `else` before a non-block body

invocations.name: do/E.hx
invocations.note: a same-line comment after an expression-position `do` (a lambda body) before a non-block body stays on the keyword line (refused on the base: the round trip dropped the comment)

invocations.name: do/N.hx
invocations.note: a same-line comment after the inner `do` of a nested do-while stays on the keyword line (refused on the base: the round trip dropped the comment)

invocations.name: cond5/C.hx
invocations.note: a #if condition group nested five deep is one condition: the parser reads it through CondCondition, and fmt writes it verbatim

invocations.name: condcomment/C.hx
invocations.note: a block comment holding an apostrophe inside a #if condition group is comment text, not a string opener

invocations.name: cond/P.hx
invocations.note: a #if region body of two or more elements puts each on a line of its own, and every branch of that region opens and closes on lines of its own with it (one-line on the base)

invocations.name: arrowbodypad/ArrowBodyPad.hx
invocations.note: an arrow-lambda body object literal pads both braces alike under objectLiteralBraces after/before with no arrowBodyOpenPad key (the base dropped only the open pad)

invocations.name: typecolon/Probe.hx
invocations.note: the colon of a named function-type parameter, an optional one included, and of a type-parameter constraint, an intersection included, follows its own key; both stay tight with no key

invocations.name: if-chain-ladder/R1.hx
invocations.note: an if with an else under fitLineIfWithElse + fitLineBodyGlue: every brace-less branch body of its chain goes on its own line, else-if links and nested chains included, one-line bodies too; a braced branch keeps `} else` and a value-if keeps its own layout

invocations.name: ladder-every-statement/T.hx
invocations.note: under fitLine an if with an else ladders in every statement position: a statement-switch case tail, a loop block that is that tail, a function body, and a function-body else-if chain whose last link has no else (the base kept them inline or half-laddered)

invocations.name: fn-body-same/N.hx
invocations.note: a named function whose body is an if / else with brace-less branches, under functionBody same: the ladder goes on its own line below the head

invocations.name: fn-body-same/S.hx
invocations.note: named and anonymous function bodies whose if / else is braced in every branch, under functionBody / anonFunctionBody same: the chain stays glued to the head

invocations.name: fn-body-same/W.hx
invocations.note: function bodies under functionBody / anonFunctionBody same: an if / else of brace-led switches and an all-braced else-if chain stay glued, a mixed chain and an else-if chain with a brace-less tail go on their own line

invocations.name: cond-siblings-off/C.hx
invocations.note: sameLine.conditionalSiblings off: a one-element branch stays beside its #if and a two-member branch breaks alone; the key was ignored before and shared the region
